patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and VektorOS share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Hive and VektorOS share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Hive only if your buying job matches “Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — ” rather than VektorOS's shape. Choose VektorOS only if your buying job matches “Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management.” rather than Hive's shape. Workflow advantage: Hive leans project-tracking, team-collaboration-work; VektorOS leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and VektorOS share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Hive is Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — strong monday.com peer.; VektorOS is Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management..
- Company-size focus: Hive (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs VektorOS (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Hive-leaning project-tracking, team-collaboration-work vs VektorOS-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Hive — Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; VektorOS — SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency.

Limitations — Hive: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams; VektorOS: SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency.

Poor-fit cases: Hive is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams · VektorOS is a poor fit when that limitation bites: SMB ops platform — limited public pricing transparency · Avoid Hive if you actually need VektorOS's motion (Business and operations software — affiliate partner in project management.)
